title: A Brand-New Song
traveler_why: Willow is the warm one who knows how kind help feels, and tonight’s psalm is about being lifted out of a pit and given a new song: stuck and grumpy over her puzzle, Willow is gently helped by Grandpa, and her stuck feeling turns into a happy little tune.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she knows the joy of being lifted up. In Willow’s world today: Willow felt stuck and grumpy because she couldn’t build her puzzle. She was about to cry when Grandpa gently helped her find the right piece. Suddenly her heart felt light and happy, and she hummed a little tune. Just like Heavenly Father lifted the psalm-writer from the pit and gave him a new song, kind help turned Willow’s stuck feeling into joy.
